raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivers 338 transactions already in earlier batches. In each re-delivered copy, txn_ts is stored as epoch milliseconds (for example 1768716261000 = 2026-01-18 06:04:21 UTC, matching the ISO copy), which the plain CAST to TIMESTAMP rejects. Parsing 13-digit epoch-ms values with epoch_ms and deduplicating on txn_id (the copies are otherwise identical) fixes silver_transactions and, through it, all gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]+') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
